project_info.color_palette: Fiery orange, neon pink, tropical yellow, red, clear water, dark metallic gray

main_subject.detail: A centered TROPICAL RUSH soda can, wet with condensation and covered in fiery fruit graphics, standing upright amid an explosive water splash and tropical fruit pile.

items: Center: upright dark soda can with large TROPICAL RUSH label.
Behind and around can: wide crown-shaped water splash with sharp droplets.
Foreground: passion fruit, pineapple, strawberry, grapes, and citrus segments.
Background: orange-to-pink saturated light field with wet reflective surface below.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp water refraction, wet can highlights, vivid color separation, cinematic splash energy

technical_specs.render_style: Professional hyper-realistic beverage poster photography, Canon 50mm look

assets.name: TROPICAL RUSH can packaging
assets.usage: Preserve label wording, tropical fruit illustration, can proportions, and cap details.

prompt_instructions: Attach the exact can artwork before rendering.
Maintain readable TROPICAL RUSH branding at center.
Use real tropical fruit and water, not generic graphic substitutes.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Three ultra-dynamic soda cans in one vibrant high-end advertising composition — a can of TROPICAL RUSH exploding with dramatic water and tropical fruit splash, vibrant orange and pink background lighting; a can of LEMON ICED splashed with cold water against a glowing green dynamic light background; both cans covered in realistic condensation and motion-blurred droplets, bursting with fruity, refreshing energy. Deep orange, pink, and neon green lighting blend together in a bold studio setup. Captured by a professional photographer using a Canon 50mm lens, hyper-realistic textures, crisp details, ultra high resolution, bright commercial poster aesthetic, rich color vibrancy, cinematic splash effects --ar 3:4
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong can label, distorted fruit, flat water, no condensation, muted color, unreadable text, poor reflections, low resolution, watermark
